title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
source: SFIA 8 (Software Development PROG Level 2-3; Systems Design DESN Level 2) & UK Government Digital, Data and Technology (DDaT) Junior Developer Framework
description: Designs, implements, tests, and deploys responsive web applications, integrating modern frontend user interfaces with secure, scalable backend REST APIs and relational databases.

rubric.1: Novice: Knows basic HTML/CSS tags and introductory programming syntax (loops, conditionals). Requires guided step-by-step assistance to build any web page.
rubric.2: Advanced Beginner: Can build simple static pages and implement basic CRUD endpoints using an existing tutorial or boilerplate. Understands common conventions with assistance.
rubric.3: Competent (Job-Ready Baseline): Autonomously develops full-stack features: builds modular React components with state management, designs RESTful API endpoints with validation, handles DB migrations, writes unit tests, and uses Git branching.
rubric.4: Proficient: Diagnoses complex frontend/backend bugs, refactors spaghetti code for testability, designs clean database schemas with indexing, and implements robust authentication/security best practices.
rubric.5: Expert: Architects full-stack distributed system designs, establishes team CI/CD standards, mentors junior engineers, and conducts high-level technical code reviews.

requirements.description: Deep understanding of ES6+, closures, promises, async/await, DOM APIs, and static typing with TypeScript interfaces and generics.
Building composable functional components, utilizing hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo, custom hooks), managing state via Context or Redux/Zustand, and client-side routing.
Designing RESTful HTTP endpoints, handling request validation, proper HTTP status codes, error middleware, and API documentation with OpenAPI/Swagger.
Designing normalized relational schemas (PostgreSQL/SQLite), writing database migrations, using ORMs (SQLAlchemy, Prisma, or TypeORM), and indexing foreign keys.

evidence_types: Unit & integration test suite in repo
requirements.description: Writing unit and integration tests using frameworks such as Pytest, Jest, or Vitest; testing API endpoints, mocking external dependencies, and validating edge cases.
Feature branching workflows, writing semantic commit messages, resolving merge conflicts, and conducting constructive peer pull request reviews.
Protecting web applications against OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities: SQL injection prevention, XSS mitigation, secure password hashing (bcrypt), CORS configuration, and JWT authentication.
Building mobile-first responsive layouts with modern CSS (Flexbox, Grid, Tailwind CSS), adhering to WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines and semantic HTML.
Writing optimized Dockerfiles for frontend and backend applications, orchestrating multi-container environments with docker-compose, and understanding container isolation.

Official React Documentation: Thinking in React & Hooks
FastAPI Official Tutorial: Building Robust RESTful APIs
Test-Driven Development with Pytest & Vitest Guide
OWASP Web Security Testing Guide & Top 10
WebAIM: Introduction to Web Accessibility & WCAG 2.1 Checklist

project_templates.title: Full-Stack Task & Workflow Management Platform
project_templates.brief: Design and build a responsive web application allowing users to manage project tasks across stages. Include JWT authentication, SQLite/PostgreSQL persistence with migrations, REST API with automated validation, and a modern React UI.
deliverables: Backend FastAPI/Express service with OpenAPI documentation and input validation
Frontend React SPA built with Tailwind CSS and accessible interactive components
Automated unit tests covering authentication and task state transitions (>75% coverage)
project_templates.evidence_output: Live deployed web application link + GitHub repository containing clean commits, unit tests, and architecture README.

project_templates.title: Containerized Developer Portfolio & Microservice Showcase
project_templates.brief: Build a production-grade personal developer showcase with Docker multi-stage builds, CI/CD pipeline automation via GitHub Actions, and an integrated status monitoring endpoint.
deliverables: Multi-stage Dockerfile and docker-compose orchestration file
Configured GitHub Actions workflow running tests and linter on every commit
Live deployed portfolio website with automated health check status
project_templates.evidence_output: Public GitHub repository with passing CI badges, container orchestration configuration, and live URL.
